claims.text: The Ministry of Defence UFO reports file covering the Calvine period is closed for another fifty years. DEFE 24/1940, 'UFO reports', 1 August 1990 to 31 January 1991, former reference D/Sec(AS)12/2 Part J, is held at Kew as a Public Record with closure code 84 under the closure criterion 'Personal information where the applicant is a 3rd party', a Freedom of Information Act exemption signed 7 June 2023, and a record opening date of 1 January 2076.

b.label: DEFE 24 and DEFE 31 - MoD UFO record series, The National Archives, Kew

edges.label: The Defence Secretariat file covering the claimed assessment is closed until 2076
edges.note: DEFE 24/1940 is the UFO reports file for 1 August 1990 to 31 January 1991 and carries a record opening date of 1 January 2076 under a Freedom of Information Act exemption signed 7 June 2023; a redacted digital copy at DEFE 24/1940/1 has been open since 20 October 2008. The edge records where the assessment would sit, not that it is there.

title: The National Archives Discovery catalogue records for DEFE 24/1940 and DEFE 24/1940/1
